anchors.description: Height of the white paper-towel roll standing on the dining table, front top rim to front base of the roll just above the table-contact line.
anchors.visible_evidence: Bright white upright cylinder with roughly 2:1 height:width ratio on the table near the far edge, with a visible flat top surface and paper-roll silhouette; matches a standard 11 in (0.279 m) kitchen paper-towel roll.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Brand/sheet count unknown; the very bottom is at the table contact just behind the foreground chair crest rail, so the lower point sits on the last clearly visible roll surface ~1-2 px above contact. A smaller (20-24 cm) roll is possible but less likely.

anchors.description: Distance between the tops of the two back stiles/finials of the front-left wooden dining chair.
anchors.visible_evidence: Ladder-back wooden dining side chair turned with its back to the camera; curved crest rail ending in two clearly visible turned finials/stile tops; both endpoints lie on the chair back.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Generic ladder-back dining chair of unknown make; overall chair width typically 0.42-0.50 m, and the chord between the two stile tops is close to but slightly narrower than the seat width.

anchors.description: Distance between the tops of the two back stiles/finials of the front-right wooden dining chair (matched pair with the front-left chair).
anchors.visible_evidence: Second ladder-back wooden dining side chair of the same visible design, back toward the camera; both turned stile tops/finials fully visible and separated by the plate on the table behind.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Same generic chair model uncertainty as a2; slight rotation about the vertical axis makes the right finial project slightly higher, but both endpoints are the back-post tops.
